sergeant_dec5f454.text: The Captain's down! Hold them — hold them!

you_a02490d0.text: Where is everyone…? Where's my unit?

you_8c767c43.text: Greycoats! My rifle — I need my rifle!

you_e1bef05e.text: And that was my last round. Only the sabre now.

you_7f4f666f.text: A road… it has to lead somewhere.

you_79acdcb9.text: Scouts… the Dominion's crawling all over these woods.

sentry1_f31168f8.text: Halt! Who goes there? Show your face!

you_99085dd8.text: Easy! I'm — I think I'm one of you!

sentry2_d7046f8c.text: Burgundy tabs on his collar… he's Marches infantry! Open the gate!

captain_9c905e0b.text: Easy, soldier. Lower that blade — you're among friends now.

you_d87ea9e8.text: Friends…? I woke up in the Thornwood. No memory, no unit — and greycoats waiting for me.

captain_e226c30b.text: Kharzan raiders. They cut down our patrol two nights past. We thought no one walked out of those woods.

sergeant_cd4e8bd1.text: Look at his collar, Captain. Burgundy tabs — Seventh Company. He's one of ours.

captain_0530dce5.text: Then welcome home, soldier. Whatever you lost out there, we'll help you find it.

youThought_9a431f84.text: (They know this uniform… They're on my side. I think.)

captain_a87de758.text: Quartermaster! Get this soldier a proper weapon. That sabre won't hold back the Dominion.

quartermaster_d18a6b05.text: Aye, Captain! Over here, friend — I've got just the thing.

quartermaster_b1628ea3.text: Rkm Model 28 automatic rifle. Twenty rounds a box, and she'll chew through them fast — so mind your bursts.

sentry2_2e33755a.text: Captain! Movement in the treeline — grey uniforms, dozens of them!

captain_1caf8171.text: KHARZANS! Everyone to the walls — hold this fort!

sergeant_b2dc1fb4.text: There's too many of them! They're coming through the wall!

soldier_3c1238d9.text: We can't hold! We can't hold!

kharzanOfficer_3da567eb.text: This one still breathes… Velmoran. Seventh Company.

kharzanOfficer_606981fb.text: Take him alive. The Marshal will want to meet the man who walked out of the Thornwood.
